title: NATS: Further dissect header fields
description:
Major and minor version are extracted from the header version as unsigned integers.
This simplifies filtering for certain allowed versions (e.g. `nats.header.version.major >= 1`).

From other header fields name and value are extracted into separate fields.

The relevant filter strings are also shortened from `nats.headers.header.xxx` to `nats.header.xxx`.
